The Comprehensive Hemophilia Treatment Center (HTC) at University Hospitals is a 340B Covered Entity that utilizes funds generated through its 340B program to offer programs and services that benefit our patients and other members of the bleeding disorder community. These programs and services include:
•	Medication access and care coordination services to help patients navigate insurance requirements, reduce financial barriers, and coordinate specialty care
•	Patient engagement programs focused on refill management and improving adherence to treatment plans
•	Education & Training for multi-disciplinary HTC staff members to ensure best possible care for patients
•	Transportation and Access to Care assistance
•	Home Health Services
•	Community Outreach & Education Initiatives
•	In-kind contributions to community organizations
Through these efforts, our Hemophilia Treatment Center enhances access to comprehensive care, improves health outcomes, reduces barriers to treatment, and provides meaningful community benefit for individuals and families affected by bleeding disorders. Participation in the 340B Program enables our organization to strengthen services that support the long-term health and well-being of patients across Northeast Ohio.
